router.description: Link + usePathname adapter so components work in Next.js and React Router

image.description: Image adapter (next/image in Next.js, in React)

data.description: Site details, navigation and component copy the components read from

viewport.description: Shared media queries and window size helpers

smooth-scroll.description: Lenis smooth scroll driven by the GSAP ticker, synced with ScrollTrigger, plus scroll lock helpers (lib/scroll)

user.description: User context with login / logout boilerplate

scroll-timeline.description: Pinned stage with one scrubbed master GSAP timeline that sections append to

button.description: Link or button with a sweep hover, solid / outline, dark / light surface

cursor.description: Custom cursor with variants driven by data-cursor attributes

local-clock.description: Live clock in the site's time zone

scroll-hint.description: "Scroll" hint that fades out near the end of the page

split-reveal.description: Text revealed line / word / char with GSAP SplitText

wordmark.description: SVG text wordmark with a fixed aspect ratio

framed-image.description: Cover image in a clipping frame with optional overscan for parallax

growing-image.description: Framed image that grows to full screen on scroll

scroll-theme.description: Page colors that blend to another theme when a section scrolls in

contact-form.description: Contact form posting to Formspree (or mailto: fallback)

header-bar.description: Fixed full-width bar with blend-mode text and a slide-down mobile menu

header-floating.description: Floating logo + rounded nav pill, dropdown menu on mobile

footer-reveal.description: Fixed footer revealed from under the page, with contact details and the contact form

footer-big-type.description: Four-column footer with a giant word overflowing the bottom edge

loading-screen.description: Once-per-session intro overlay with a counter, locks scroll while it runs

hero-fullscreen.description: Full-screen hero, left or centered, with CTA buttons and a divider bar

scroll-reveal-text.description: Paragraph that lights up character by character on scroll
